Pending legacy data.change and domain.state claims need not be treated as trusted or required: this specification introduces neither shared data nor persistent state. An independent active, non-autoassignable reviewer is configured for the earlier review prerequisite. No material unresolved Decision is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is consistent. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the manifest/evaluation source-digest distinction and PRD trimming normalization are explicitly documented. The supplied isolation evidence distinguishes retained old-version operations from this unrun bundle and supplies no candidate outputs. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and provenance; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or create any human attestation.
